crossRefs.note: If iniquity is in your hand, put it far away. Don’t let unrighteousness dwell in your tents.
the wicked man writhes in pain all his days, even the number of years that are laid up for the oppressor.
For the company of the godless will be barren, and fire will consume the tents of bribery.
“Behold, I know your thoughts, the plans with which you would wrong me.
For you say, ‘Where is the house of the prince? Where is the tent in which the wicked lived?’
Isn’t your wickedness great? Neither is there any end to your iniquities.
I hold fast to my righteousness, and will not let it go. My heart will not reproach me so long as I live.
“Let my enemy be as the wicked. Let him who rises up against me be as the unrighteous.
Because I delivered the poor who cried, and the fatherless also, who had no one to help him,
“I made a covenant with my eyes, how then should I look lustfully at a young woman?
Yahweh, my God, if I have done this, if there is iniquity in my hands,
All this has come on us, yet we haven’t forgotten you. We haven’t been false to your covenant.
If you want to seek God diligently, make your supplication to the Almighty.
If you were pure and upright, surely now he would awaken for you, and make the habitation of your righteousness…
If I cherished sin in my heart, the Lord wouldn’t have listened.
But most certainly, God has listened. He has heard the voice of my prayer.
The sacrifice made by the wicked is an abomination to Yahweh, but the prayer of the upright is his delight.
I desire therefore that the men in every place pray, lifting up holy hands without anger and doubting.

translations.web: Although there is no violence in my hands, and my prayer is pure.
translations.bsb: yet my hands are free of violence and my prayer is pure.
translations.kjv: Not for any injustice in mine hands: also my prayer is pure.
translations.asv: Although there is no violence in my hands, And my prayer is pure.
